newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint closes steady against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint closes steady against dollar.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed quiet trade on Monday almost unchanged against the dollar, dealers said.
The forint finished at 150.73 compared with its opening 150.75/80 and the morning session's closing 150.72/77.
Dealers said the forint was influenced by dollar/mark, and it traded five to 10 pips weaker than the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) floating resistance level (bid).
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5-percent wide intervention range against a basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu.
The Swiss franc, which started trading November futures on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), firmed and accounted for almost half of the BCE currency futures turnover on Monday.
Dollar and yen futures mostly dropped. The mark closed mixed while Ecu futures were firm to steady.
